sn35.150:1.1: Nibbānasappāyaṃ vo bhikkhave paṭipadaṃ desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || la || || Katamā ca sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā patipadā || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.150:3.1: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.150:5.1: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassitum Etam mama eso hamasmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.150:9.1: Cakkhuviññāṇam || Cakkhusamphasso || la || Yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.150:13.1: kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.150:15.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati rūpesu pi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati || Cakkhusamphasse pi nibbindati || pe || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tasmim nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā ti || || Anantevāsikam
